chapter.verse: Tuk lai tak-a vukkia, leh an lak hun-a guahzu bangin, pahtawina in mihaite’ adingin a kilawmna om lo hi.
Thu om lopi-in hong kisamsiatna in bangmah hong cih thei lo a, khawlna mun mel a nei lo a lengsuk a lengto Phialphiah tawh kibang lel hi.
Sakolte sat ding kisam a, Late kamkaih bulh ding kisam a, mihaite zong satloh phamawh hi.
Mite’ hai thudotna dawngdawng lecin, nang zong amau mah banga a hai na hi hi.
Mihaite a pil kisa kha ding uh ahih manin, amau’ haina tawh kizui-in dawng in.
Mihai khat kamtai-a a zangpa in, ama khe mah a sattan tawm, siatna a zongpa ahi hi.
Khebaipa’ khe, kiman’na om loin a kikhai mawk bangin, mihaite’ adingin paunak in bangmah man nei lo hi.
Saili kuangah sailungtang khihcip lehang a phattuamna a om loh mah bangin, mihaite pahtawina in a mawkna ahi hi.
Mihaite in paunak thuhilhnate a paukhiat ciangin, zu khampa in a khut-a ling om a khei dinga kipan tawh kibang lel hi.
Mihai a tuahkhak peuh tha cial-a a neipa in, a tuahkhak peuh a bankap thaltawipa tawh kibang hi.
Ui in a luak a zuat kik bangin, mihaite a haitat ngei bangin ta kik zel hi.
A pil lo kimlai pil a kisapa sangin, mihaite’ adingin lametna om zaw lai hi.
Thadahpa in, “Lampi-ah humpinelkai om! Kongzingah humpinelkai om!” ci-in lumlum hi.
Kongkhak in kawmheek tungah a kiheihei lel bangin, mi thadahpa a lupna tungah kiheihei hi.
Thadahpa in a khut-in ankuang sung sawk suk a, a kam-ah a bahtoh ding nangawn gim zungzung kisa hi.
A kilawm-a thu a dawng thei mihing sagih sangin, mi thadahpa ama ngaihsutna-ah pil kisa zaw hi.
Eite tawh a kisai lo kitotna sunga va kiphumna in, ui ommuang khat a bil-a kaihsak tawh kibang hi.
A vengte a khem khit ciangin, ka ciamnuihna hi, a cipa pen,
sih theihna gu a baang thaltang tawh a kappa tawh kibang hi.
Sing om kei leh mei mit a, gensiatna om kei leh kitotna bei hi.
Meihol in mei am ding piangsak a, sing in mei kuangsak a, migilo in kitotna piangsak hi.
Gensiatna in a lim mahmah an tawh kibang a, mihingte’ sungtawng pekah tumsuk pahpah hi.
Tungtham bek-a kamkhum pauna in, cimbeng kizut leibel tawh kibang hi.
Mi simtatte in a kampi bek tawh thuhoih gen a, a lungsim ah zuauthu bek om hi.
A lungsim-ah a deihhuai lo thu sagih tak om ahih manin, kam khum tak-a a pau manin um kha kei in.
Ama hoih lohna a ip nop hangin, mi khempeuh in ama gitlohna thei veve hi.
Mi siahna-in gum a tote, ama gum tawhna sung mah-ah amah leh kiat zawsop a, mi a deng kha dinga suang a khukte, ama suang khuk mah in amah leh khak zaw hi.
Zuau genna in midik kim lai a mawh bangsak a, tungtham bek-a thugenna in siatna bek piangsak hi.
